g.text: While I am slightly dubious of your reframing of the situation, I am... too tempted by this new future an what it might mean for me to resist it, Drifter dear.

g.title: j3623899415
g.text: While I am... slightly dubious of your reframing of your events as a tactical retreat, I admit I am... in favor of it, all the same, Drifter dear.

g.title: j2832841710
g.text: And our attachment, therefore, to time. I ask you now. No, I beseech you, to wield it now on my behalf. Take these thoughts away from me. Take these memories away from me.

g.title: j3447879091
g.text: Then very well. So be it. I will not ask this of you now. But if you have never once done it for your own amusement, curiosity, or to seek to undue errors you have made in the dealings with others?!

g.title: j3098068334
g.text: This "new lease" on my life. Very well. I concede and accept your argument. Thank you, Drifter, for... talking me off this particular ledge.
